publish.note: Duplicate: the sale of the San Francisco Centre mall is carried by the Chronicle entry dated 2026-10-22 on the 865 Market Street page (2026-10-23-sc-0001); this account names 25 Taylor Street only in passing.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 25 TAYLOR ST → parcel 0343032; sf-parcels has blklot 0343032 active, 25–27 TAYLOR; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1922. EAS puts 1, 25 TAYLOR ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 1. EAS files the address under parcel 0343002, which sf-parcels reports retired; the active parcel its coordinates fall in is 0343032.
